defs.def: developing, growing, etc. gradually and in an even and regular way （发展、增长等）稳步的，持续的，匀速的

ex.s: I might be able to get attention ___7___, but you have the strength for steady growth.
The steady improvement in her taste.
ex.t: 向注册办公室提出请求。

defs.def: not changing and not interrupted 稳定的；恒定的
firmly fixed, supported or balanced; not shaking or likely to fall down 稳的；平稳的；稳固的
sensible; who can be relied on 人
to stop yourself/sb/sth from moving, shaking or falling; to stop moving, shaking or falling 使稳；使平稳；稳住

ex.s: Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!
ex.t: 当然，我希望在金钱方面有更多的自由，毫无疑问，我总有一天会办张信用卡，但我目前还没有稳定的收入，所以办信用卡可能会诱惑我超支花钱！

ex.s: The pipe’s steady drip onto the tree’s roots was giving it just enough water at the perfect rate to grow strong and quickly.
ex.t: 水管稳定地滴在树根上，刚好以恰到好处的速度给予它足够的水分，让它茁壮而快速地成长。

ex.s: The first was the steady state theory, which holds that the universe has no beginning or end.
ex.t: 第一种是稳恒态理论，它认为宇宙没有开始也没有结束。

ex.s: The biggest champion of the steady state concept was Fred and in the 1940s, he and several other people founded the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, now one of NASA’s leading space-exploration centres.
ex.t: 稳恒态理论最大的拥护者是弗雷德，在20世纪40年代，他和其他几个人创立了喷气推进实验室，现在它是美国宇航局领先的太空探索中心之一。

ex.s: It is the first movement of an approach towards that state of mental purity which alone can fit us for a full and steady perception of moral beauty as well as physical adaptation.
ex.t: 这是朝着那种心灵纯净状态迈出的第一步，只有这种纯净才能使我们完满而稳定地感知到道德之美，以及物理上的适应。

defs.def: to stop changing and become regular again 恢复平稳；稳定下来
to make sb/sth calm 使平静；使冷静；使镇定
（要求对方注意言行）哎，注意点
（提醒对方小心）注意，当心，小心
